summary: Great-great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison; his wife Bethia Horton was a granddaughter of William Wells.
bio:
His marriage to Bethia Horton gives the Harrisons a second, independent blood link to John through William Wells.

Son of John Tuthill (1635-1717) and Deliverance King, so a brother of John's 10th-great-grandfather John Tuthill Jr (John's 10th-great-granduncle, not a cousin). Akerly ([R4-S1]) cites his will (N.Y. Liber 17, p. 118) and lists children Henry (1690), Jonathan (1695-1741, m. Susannah L'Hommedieu, granddaughter of Thomas Brinley, auditor to Charles I), Nathaniel (drowned 1727), Barnabas and Bethia (m. Samuel Landon). A family record ([R4-S2]) says he died 4 Jan 1750 aged 84.
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 7-9 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker

[R4-S2] George F. Horton, Horton Genealogy, or Chronicles of the Descendants of Barnabas Horton (1876) (archive.org full text), family record (secondary) https://archive.org/details/hortongenealogyo00hort
